message: Thanks for the comment, Angie! I agree there's a big difference between the BLUF/SOP mindset common to much of the military and the study of the available means of persuasion -- if you're interested in those intersections, you might get a kick out of a [special issue of *Kairos*](http://kairos.technorhetoric.net/14.3/) I co-guest-edited on the topic. I'm checking out your blog with interest -- no, with pleasure. That's some intense writing. Looking forward to reading more likewise.
